title: Glass Shelf With Towel Bar 16-Inch Solid Brass Wall-Mounted | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
description:
Clear bathroom clutter with a wall-mounted glass shelf that also adds a dedicated spot for towels. This glass shelf (bathroom shelf / wall shelf) includes an integrated towel bar so you get storage and towel-hanging in one coordinated piece.

Highlights:
- Keep items from sliding off with a solid brass gallery rail.
- Count on strength and safety with 3/8-Inch thick tempered glass.
- Add a convenient towel bar (towel rack / towel holder) for hand towels or washcloths near the sink.
- Install a clean look with concealed screw mounting hardware.
- Coordinate with the Waverly Place collection—ideal for matching Waverly Place and other transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware.

Specs & Installation:
- Type: Glass shelf with towel bar; wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging installation
- Dimensions: 16-Inch length x 5-Inch width; projection 5 Inches; height 12 Inches
- Glass thickness: 0.38 Inches (3/8-Inch)
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Material: solid brass (brass construction) hardware
- Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware; screw size #8 x 1 1/4"
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish variety: Multiple designer finish options available
